owner_direction.priority: A good overall model and a high-quality paper; changing domain is permitted if the current focus is not the best first step.

decision: Continue reusable general-model and execution preparation. Retain the current document/history research design as a conditional candidate under its existing novelty, pilot, matching, numerical and cost gates. No immediate domain pivot is justified by this review alone.
contract_effect: Advisory pre-results review; no replacement of catalog-selected contracts, budgets, source-use restrictions, model size, tokenizer or launch authority. A failed gate triggers an explicit coherent successor before confirmatory outputs.
primary_risks: Young 350M parents may not support the proposed natural-task difficulty.
Targeted long-context training, hybrid scaling and discourse-state diagnostics have substantial prior art.
Three paired seed contrasts can leave interaction uncertainty unresolved.
Production source capacity and coherent task/partition inputs remain incomplete.
A 320B-token from-scratch release has not demonstrated competitiveness with more heavily trained public models.
scope_change_rule: If review/pilots show inadequate novelty, learnability, matching or affordability, preserve the negative evidence and replace affected data/study/evaluation/budget/paper contracts together. Do not silently revive retired experiments or narrow general capability to manufacture a headline.
